# Avonstowe

> Avonstowe is a construction and engineering disputes practice working across the United Kingdom, the Middle East and North Africa: quantum analysis, claims and commercial recovery, and commercial management.

## Services
- Forensic quantum analysis: Quantum assessment, document review, analysis of project records and report drafting in arbitration, adjudication and litigation.
- Claims, disputes and commercial recovery: Prolongation, disruption, variations, loss and expense, final accounts and payment disputes, for employers, contractors and subcontractors.
- Quantity surveying and commercial management: Procurement, contract management, valuation, change control, cost forecasting and final account, under JCT, NEC, FIDIC and bespoke forms.

## About Michael
- Michael Whiting, Principal. RICS Expert Witness Certificate; BSc (Hons) Quantity Surveying; Member, Society of Construction Law; LLB (Hons) (expected 2027); Diploma in Forensic Quantum Analysis (in progress).
- Michael is a quantum and claims consultant with over 12 years’ experience in construction and engineering disputes across the United Kingdom, the Middle East and North Africa. His work covers quantum, commercial and contractual matters, on live projects and in arbitration, adjudication, court proceedings and negotiated settlement. He supports appointed experts and advises employers, contractors and subcontractors on prolongation, disruption, variations, productivity, loss and expense, final accounts, payment disputes and commercial recovery. He began his career at sixteen as an apprentice quantity surveyor with Balfour Beatty. His experience spans procurement and live project delivery through to dispute resolution, across energy, industrial, infrastructure and construction projects, under JCT, NEC, FIDIC, PFI and bespoke contracts.
- Career: Avonstowe 2022 to present; McLaren Construction 2019 to 2022; Balfour Beatty 2014 to 2019.
